dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped rings featuring a high-contrast transition from a dark charcoal background to light-grey perimeters. The geometry of the prominent central lateral rings is irregular and crenulated, with some structures showing incomplete, open-arc boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-grey pixel clusters located primarily in the anterior neck and lower-lateral regions. These clusters lack internal gradients and are interspersed between the larger annular rings.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest lateral macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle across the mid-section. A cluster of smaller centroids in the neck region forms a roughly linear sequence following the curve of the anterior dorsal ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Physical occlusion of the posterior flipper and lower tail region by several bright green, linear blades of terrestrial vegetation (grass) overlapping the dark pixel data.
